terms.meaning: A standard sequence of objects, names or written symbols in a fixed order, used to represent numbers.
A symbol that represents a number in a written number system.
An easily recognised number used as a reference point, often with its own symbol. In Roman numerals, X and C stand for the landmark numbers 10 and 100.
A system whose landmark numbers are the powers of n: 1, n, n², n³… Base 10 is also called the decimal system.
A number system where a symbol's position decides its value. It is also called a positional system.
The place value system with 10 digits, including 0, used across the world today. It is also called the Indian or Hindu-Arabic number system.

items.name: Writing a number in a base
items.formula: Take the largest landmark number first

items.name: Egyptian number system
items.formula: Base 10, with a new symbol for each power of 10

items.name: Mesopotamian (Babylonian) system
items.example: 1 hour = 60 minutes and 1 minute = 60 seconds come from this system.

items.name: Mayan system
items.example: The third place is 360, not 20 × 20 = 400, so it is not a true base-20 system.

items.name: Value of a Hindu numeral
items.formula: Each digit × the power of 10 for its place

items.name: First known use of the digit 0
items.example: It wrote numbers with ten digits around the 3rd century CE, with 0 as a dot.

items.name: Who first fully explained the 10-symbol system
items.example: He also used it for long scientific calculations.

items.name: How the Indian numerals spread
items.example: Al-Khwarizmi (around 825) and Al-Kindi (around 830) wrote about them. Fibonacci argued for them in Europe around 1200.

mistakes.text: A number and a numeral are different. The number is the amount; the numeral is the symbol. X and 10 are two numerals for the same number.
The Mayan third place is 360, not 400. Do not take the system to be a true base-20 system.
Roman numerals are not a base system, because their landmark numbers are not all powers of one number. 5 and 50 are not powers of 10.
In a place value system, 0 keeps the place empty. 305 and 35 are different numbers because of the 0.
